summary: OpenRouter lists the stealth model Crouton Alpha (stealth/crouton-alpha) at $0 per million input and output tokens during the anonymous-provider preview, released November 3, 2026. It takes text, image, video, file and audio input with a 1,048,576-token context. OpenRouter states prompts and completions may be retained by the provider but are not used for training. No end date is stated; earlier stealth models lost their free price once the preview ended.
claim_steps: Sign in or create an account at openrouter.ai.
Create an API key at openrouter.ai/settings/keys.
Call the model with slug stealth/crouton-alpha via the OpenAI-compatible API at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 (or pick it in any OpenRouter-supported app).
